problems.issue: Relying solely on a social media profile (Facebook) instead of a dedicated, standalone business website.
problems.impact: Limits brand credibility, search engine optimization (SEO) potential, and full control over the user journey and booking capabilities.

problems.issue: Lack of direct call-to-action (CTA) elements such as online appointment booking or direct consultation links visible in the page metadata.
problems.impact: Friction in converting prospective social media visitors into paying dental patients.

problems.issue: Insufficient structured schema markup for local business and dental services in the HTML head.
problems.impact: Reduces visibility in local search engine results pages (SERPs) and Google Maps for high-intent local queries.

opportunities: Build a dedicated mobile-responsive website integrated with an online appointment scheduling system.
Implement local SEO strategies and schema markup to capture high-intent dental search traffic in Manila.
Showcase patient testimonials, before-and-after galleries, and detailed service descriptions to build immediate trust.
audit.summary: Manila Dental Care Center currently relies on a Facebook profile as its primary digital presence, which limits its search visibility, professional branding, and patient conversion efficiency. Transitioning to a dedicated website with local SEO and online booking will significantly enhance patient acquisition.

outreach.subject: Quick thought on Manila Dental Care Center's online presence
outreach.body:
Hi there,

I was looking at Manila Dental Care Center's Facebook page and noticed how active your community is. 

However, relying solely on social media means you're likely missing out on patients searching Google for local dentists, since there's no dedicated website or easy way for folks to book appointments online directly.

We put together a quick, live demo of what a simple, modern site with instant booking could look like for your clinic. 

Would it be useful if I sent it over?

Best,
Rahul

---

outreach.subject: Quick note about DR Smile Manila's search visibility
outreach.body:
Hi there,

I was looking at the DR Smile Manila landing page and noticed the site looks clean and works well for patient bookings. However, I spotted a quick technical snag: there's an accidental 'noindex' tag hiding the page from Google, meaning new patients searching locally are likely missing you. Plus, adding local business schema could help you pop up with operating hours right in the search results.

We put together a quick live demo with these fixes in place. Would it be useful if I sent it over?

Best,
Rahul
